08-08.text_de: 1969 machte der Fotograf Iain Macmillan auf dem berühmten Zebrastreifen der Abbey Road in London das Foto, das zum Cover des Beatles-Albums „Abbey Road“ wurde.
08-08.text_en: In 1969, photographer Iain Macmillan took the photo on the famous Abbey Road zebra crossing in London that became the cover of the Beatles' album Abbey Road.

08-09.text_de: 1944 genehmigte die US-Forstbehörde Smokey Bear als neues Maskottchen für den Waldbrandschutz – er löste damit Bambi in dieser Rolle ab.
08-09.text_en: In 1944, the U.S. Forest Service officially authorized Smokey Bear as its fire-prevention mascot, taking over the role previously played by Bambi.
